claim_register.claim: The C&A request adds Sabre Native, BTS, BCSStella, APEX, Razor FX, Razor ALM, and Murex trade processing for PV and non-PV rules. Country and product scope is global/all. Sabre and Razor trade messages retain the TDS3-to-message-bridge path; Falcon integration uses a real-time API. It calls for exponential-backoff Falcon retries, three times, without manual intervention. Exception handling refers to 5xx and 4xx codes but explicitly leaves technical-exception decisions for user confirmation. Only certain error codes receive three automatic retries; business/data-quality issues alert Ops. This does not define the missing code inventory or recovery contract.
